entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. I've been on hold for ten minutes. I need to speak to someone right now!
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I bought your garbage cycling shoes and they're destroying my feet! I want a refund, and I want it now. This is a complete ripoff!

I'm very sorry to hear about your experience. I can definitely look into this for you. To start, could you please tell me, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

The issue is I have massive blisters on my heels after one ride! I spent an hour setting up the cleats perfectly, and the shoes still chewed up my feet. This isn't a preference, it's a defective product!

I understand your frustration, getting blisters is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Let me pull up your order so I can see what our options are. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF122-98B. And if you tell me I can't return them, I swear I'll be speaking to your manager and leaving a review on every single website you can imagine.

Thank you for that. One moment... Okay, I see the order right here. You purchased the Aero-Stride cycling shoes, delivered six days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day window for a return.
So? What does that mean? Are you going to give me my money back or not?

Yes, absolutely. I can process this return for you right away. I am emailing you a prepaid return label as we speak. Just pack the shoes back in the box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives the item, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Oh. A full refund? And the label is prepaid?
That's correct. No cost to you. You should see the email in the next few minutes. The refund itself will appear in your account within 3 to 5 business days after we receive the return.
Okay. Fine. That's... acceptable. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
